"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}],"traits":{"Cohesion":4,"Syntax":5,"Vocabulary":5,"Phraseology":4,"Grammar":4,"Conventions":5}}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; "},{"span_id":"1440:1@U017","start":1747,"end":1789,"text":"Please dont change the time of the school."}]},{"essay_id":"8745:1","overall":5,"spans":[{"span_id":"8745:1@U001","start":0,"end":106,"text":"In many student's life, there is a set goal of succeeding in school in order to open doors in the future. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}]}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique.
